notes.title: Patch notes: v0.1.1
notes.notes:
Bug fixes

 Petting an egg while it hatches no longer locks the cursor.
 Fixed multiple softlocks related to the egg or egg shells.
 No longer able to pet kobolds as they are swimming.
 Borderless window option in settings now switches to borderless mode correctly.
 Window resolutions in settings now apply to the window size correctly.


Added

 Hatch multiplier when petting eggs.
 In-game console.
 Cheat codes.


Known bugs

 Kobolds displaying water particles and/or wrong animations when entering or exiting areas near water.
 Some eggs/egg shells display the wrong or no texture.


I've noticed others petting eggs before they hatched thinking this helped but it actually did nothing. Petting eggs now makes the eggs hatch twice as fast! The multiplier is removed when not petting.

If your keyboard supports it, pressing the "shift" and "` or ~" keys at the same opens a console window. If you experience any slowdowns or issues, the problem may be displayed here.

With only 2 mini-games, the process of gaining money for eggs can be tedious. I've added two cheat codes that add money, type them exactly in the console and press enter.

cheats.kaching - adds 1,000 coins
cheats.motherlode - adds 10,000 coins


If you experience any bugs or glitches don't hesitate to list them in the forums or on discord, happy gardening!

notes.title: Smol Kobold Garden Launch! + Post-Launch Patch incoming
notes.notes:
Smol Kobold Garden has officially launched in Early Access on Steam!

Thank you all for showing support during these very early days, it means and helps out so much! There is a ton of content planned for the next few updates I would like to take this time to go over.

The roadmap featured in-game shows a few bigger upcoming features. These are more longer term goals. We will be focusing on some smaller features to build up more content before we take on those bigger features.

Things I'm looking to add in the next few updates are:


 Controller support
 Baby kobolds
 Shop items that effect kobold stats
 More animal types
 Finishing up the other mini-games
 And other smol things


I'm also working on a post-launch patch that will address bugs and a few minor glitches that were found which should launch later today or tomorrow.

Thank you again for playing and supporting our game!
